description: Classification-decision token emitted by the solution-authoring gate at decision time. Written by the agent (L0), which since issue #1003 is the stream's only producer — the L1 PostToolUse event logger that formerly corroborated it was retired. Consumed by gate-reconciliation-core.ps1 (L2) and the Code-Critic missed-gate perspective (L3).

decision_id.description: Slug identifying this decision — matches the engagement-record decision_id or finding_dispositions finding_id.

phase.description: Pipeline phase in which the gate fired.

outcome.description: How the gate resolved. 'asked' = the decision was put to the engineer. All other values = lawful skip.

classification.description: The gate's classification of the decision. 'not-applicable' covers some gate-fails/greenfield-defer cases (genuinely n/a decisions). 'routine' is also a valid pairing with outcome 'gate-fails': the announce path (#786) emits gate-fails + routine together for a determined-outcome scope-classification announcement — a deliberate, documented pairing, not a bug.

window_position.description: Which gate firing position this token belongs to. 'pre-ask' = the classification-gate's pre-dispatch firing position — an upstream question when the outcome is indeterminate, or a determined-outcome announcement (no question) at the same firing position, e.g. the #786 scope-classification announce path. 'disposition' = adversarial finding disposition (#615 surface). 'judge-merge' = plan judge-merge disposition (#605 surface). 'review-disposition' = review-verdict disposition gate firing position.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the token was emitted.

session_key.description: Optional: the session key naming the token's own log file, derived by Resolve-GateSessionKey (skills/solution-authoring/scripts/Resolve-GateSessionKey.ps1). It records which stream the token was written to; it no longer correlates against a second producer, since the L1 event logger was retired in issue #1003.

issue_number.description: The GitHub issue number this decision belongs to. Required for all phases except 'review-disposition' window. For review-disposition tokens, use pull_request_number instead.

pull_request_number.description: The GitHub PR number this decision belongs to. Required when window_position is 'review-disposition'. Mutually exclusive with issue_number for that window.

skip_reason.description: Optional human-readable note when outcome is a lawful skip. Never present when outcome = 'asked'.
